analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the task. Instead of tracking the 5 sequential rolls and recording the top face of each cube after each roll (as instructed), it fixated on the initial state of the third cube being yellow and assumed that constituted 'one roll' of yellow. It ignored the explicit roll-by-roll tracking in the ground truth, which shows yellow never appeared on top in any of the 5 rolls. This is a failure in temporal reasoning (misordering events) and counting (failing to tally actual occurrences across time). The model’s reasoning is internally consistent but based on a misinterpretation of the video’s dynamic events, leading to an incorrect answer of 1 instead of the correct 0.
